notes.title: HUGE CONTENT UPDATE + WINTER SALE!
notes.content:
It’s been about a month since Ritual Night launched on Steam, and with the spooky season behind us, we’re ready to kick off the Winter Arc for Ritual Night! ❄️

As the cold season approaches, it’s the perfect time to roll out our first massive content update, and we’re excited to take you all to the MAD MOUNTAINS 🏔️.

This new update introduces a research facility deep in Antarctica, where human researchers discovered an ancient Cthulhu ritual circle hidden inside an ice cave. After setting up their camp, things quickly take a terrifying turn as they realize they aren't alone…

Years later, human operatives are sent to investigate the scene and collect data, but the Monsters have arrived, ready to carry out their own ritual! Now, the humans must navigate the chaos, while the Director insists they use this as a chance to learn more about the monsters—and maybe even sabotage their ritual!

Along with this new map, we're introducing 3 new Party Games to keep things fresh and exciting!

Winter Sale - Invite Your Friends!
And that's not all—Ritual Night will be 80% off for the Steam Winter Sale! That means you can grab the game for just $0.99 (down from $4.99)! If you've got any friends who were on the fence about joining the fun, now’s the perfect time to invite them to the Ritual Circle!

A huge thank you to everyone in the community for your continued support and participation in the dev sessions. Your involvement has made this journey unforgettable, and we can’t wait for the next chapter as we summon Cthulhu together! 🐙

See you in the MAD MOUNTAINS! 🌨️

notes.title: MEGAMORPH, Advanced Tutorial, QoL. v0.3.3.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Summary:[/h1]
[olist]
[*] MegaMorph Change for more chaos
[*] New Advanced Tutorial: awards some cosmetics through achievements!
[*] Quality of Life Changes
[*] Leveling Changes
[*] Bug Fixes
[/olist]
[h1]Gameplay[/h1]

[h2]MegaMorph[/h2]
Megamorph turns [b]all characters[/b] in range into the same [b]color[/b] npc. If caster is disguised, megamorph will also turn them into that same color.
Random color for each -> [b]Same color for each[/b]
Player characters in range -> [b]All characters[/b] in range

[i]Create more chaos and allows humans to get away with devious actions easier, if players decided to foolishly group up[/i]

[h2]4 Player Voting Rule - Unique to 4 Players:[/h2]
If Sacrifice Vote is tied 2-2, and the monsters voted for the same person. That person is overruled to be sacrifice. Instead of random.

[h1]Quality of Life Changes:[/h1]

Barrel Targeting:
If Player is super near a barrel and stops moving, it will auto prioritize the barrel over everything else. Should help with interacting (or burning..) barrels when a lot of players are near the same one.

Push-to-Talk: Implemented push to talk option in audio settings instead of voice activation

Hover Wardrobe Items: In wardrobe, hovering items will popup the item's name and rarity.

Mouse-Click Ping: Can Press the Ping Button with the mouse now to visually create a speech bubble to say what ingredient was found to anyone near by

[h1]Props[/h1]
Improved collider tracking when inside a cardboard box, so correctly hides your name and cosmetics

Some strange things have happened in the dungeon..

[h1]Leveling[/h1]
Reduced Early levels for leveling BattlePass
Increased Battle Pass Xp earned from daily and weekly quests!
Reduced Xp thresholds needed for leveling cosmetics.
Increased value of SP Boosts!

[h1]Major Bugs[/h1]
Fixed stats for Quests and Achievements that were not tracking. 
Field Of Vision going inside walls.
Cardboard box kicking resulting in players being stun locked.



Thank you to our discord community for reporting this bugs and providing suggestions! Looking forward to seeing you all out our next community sessions. Join our [url=discord.gg/ritualnight]discord[/url] to find out when the next one is!
Join to get sneak-peaks of the next major content-update!

Much Love from Cthulhu,
Folly

notes.title: v0.3.0.1-a Patch
notes.content:
Hi Cthulhu's Monsters,

[h1]Mini Patches with improvements:[/h1]

[h2]Ui[/h2]
Added Play with Devs Countdown
Localization improvements

[h2]QoL[/h2]
Increased player volume max
Voice-chat toggleable when you are KOed. [i]In Gather phase, Koed player can talk. In Ritual/Sacrifice players cannot talk, but can vote.[/i]
Fixed some graphical issues with some hint popups. 

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
Hid the Cardboard box in lobby area, which lead to being stun-locked into the kick animation
Jail: If player gets morphed: won't magically phase through jail wails to leave jail or go into jail.

[h2]Performance[/h2]
Increased each game server capacity to handle 8 player lobbies to be more smooth

notes.title: Ritual Night - Update v0.3.0.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Thanks to everyone who hopped onto Ritual Night on Day 1! We're excited to see new and returning players come and play some sessions throughout our first day

We've received a few posts on the bug board and we were hard at work addressing these issues for our hotfix v0.3.0.1.

Here's what we've fixed in v0.3.0.1
- [Critical] Fixes to voice chat not working in China/Asian regions, as well as random disconnects. Players should be able to hear each other smoothly!
- Cross regional rooms are now able to connect to each other, so feel free to join others from across the world!
- Equipping cosmetics issue in lobby
- NPC's now have various colors other than red.
- Various QOL changes

These changes are now LIVE! Make sure to update and check for the Version number: v0.3.0.1

Excited to have more lobbies pop up throughout the week, especially when we have our Play w/ the Devs sessions on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/ritualnight]Discord[/url]! See you all at the Ritual!

notes.title: We Are Part Of October's Next Fest + DEMO IS LIVE NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Ritual Night's demo is live NOW[/h1]
[b]Demo Details[/b]: you’ll get to experience a beginner variant of our map, "The Mansion". This eerie location will give you a taste of the chaotic gameplay as you uncover roles, sabotage, and deceive. However, this is just the beginning! Upon launch, we'll have two maps and 6 advanced variants of those maps.

[h2]October Next Fest[/h2]
We’re excited to announce that Ritual Night will be part of this October's Steam Next Fest! Our team has been hard at work for the past 4 years polishing the game to perfection, adding features, and ensuring it’s ready for you to experience firsthand.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41609440/6c9f55319e40d0ee151faaad35dc207a51732587.png[/img]

[h2]Why you should join us:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Deceive Your Friends[/b]: Create or destroy friendships. Human operatives can lie, sabotage, and create chaos, doing everything in their power to stop the summoning. This can lead to funny but tense situations.
[*] [b]No Early Eliminations[/b]: Whether you’re a seasoned player or new to social deduction, fear not! In Ritual Night, there are no early eliminations, so the fun and chaos keep rolling for everyone throughout the game.
[*] Refined Chaos: Hidden roles and randomized tools keep everyone on edge, as no direct clues can reveal the true identity of the monsters. Even if one imposter is exposed, they still have tricks up their sleeve to create even more confusion.
[*] [b]Roguelite Elements[/b]: With procedurally generated props and player abilities that evolve as you progress, no two games are ever the same. The madness unfolds differently each time you play.
[*] [b]Lore and Secrets[/b]: Uncover the deep mysteries surrounding the dark forces at play. Ciphers, lore, and secrets are waiting to be discovered as you work towards the ultimate summoning.
[/list]

Join us now and during Steam Next Fest this October to dive into the world of Ritual Night and share your feedback with us. We can’t wait to summon chaos together!
